newsitem.title: CANADA: Heart disease is main killer for Canadian women.
newsitem.headline: Heart disease is main killer for Canadian women.

text.p: Cardiovascular diseases are the main cause of death for Canadian women, accounting for 40 percent of all deaths, but only 17 percent of them realize that, the Heart and Stroke Foundation of Canada said Friday.

"The reality is that even though mortality has declined by about 50 percent, cardiovascular diseases are the number one cause of death in women as in men," said cardiologist Andy Wielgosz, adviser with the foundation.
"Women need to take care and take charge."
The foundation quoted figures from a recent poll, which also showed that 58 percent of women put the health of their families ahead of their own.
